description: Read bounded pages of the verified API-key wallet's ordinary current-store runs. Requires explicit history:read. Literal case-sensitive question search; storeNetwork describes the deployment, not per-run settlement. Recorded spend/allocation is not a payment receipt. No wallet selector, linked accounts, archive, private jobs, research or payment.

cursor.description: Opaque cursor from your previous page with identical filters; preserve it exactly.

from.description: Inclusive creation-time lower bound in canonical UTC with milliseconds, e.g. 2026-01-01T00:00:00.000Z.

funding.description: Filter the recorded funding label; this label does not verify settlement.

limit.description: Maximum rows in this page, 1-50 inclusive; defaults to 25.

search.description: Literal case-sensitive substring in your recorded questions, up to 200 characters.

surface.description: Filter by recorded originating surface; unknown retains missing provenance.

to.description: Inclusive creation-time upper bound in the same canonical UTC format; must not precede from.

name: history_read
title: Read your attributed dispatch history
